profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Oracle | Computer Software Engineering
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Oracle, my journey in tech has been guided by a commitment to innovation and problem-solving. With a Computer Science background from the University of Central Missouri, I've honed skills in MySQL, full-stack development, and Git, which have been pivotal in my role. 

My tenure at Oracle has been marked by a passion for creating seamless software solutions and an eagerness to embrace modern technologies as well as supporting existing systems. Looking ahead, I am open to roles that leverage my expertise in full-stack or front-end development, and I'm ready to contribute to a new team anywhere in the United States.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Participated in the full stack development of internal convention tool using React and Ruby on Rails, resulting in a 20% increase in topic proposals.

• Develop a React application that delivers patient dashboard summaries, improving data accessibility and decision-making for healthcare providers.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to diagnose and resolve issues in microservices using Docker and Kubernetes, boosting system stability and scalability.

• Optimize complex SQL queries and streamline database architecture, reducing triage incidents by 3-4 per month.

• Supported the migration from Ruby on Rails to Golang, improving system concurrency and processing speed for large-scale applications.

• Integrate the APPLINK API to automate patient chart procedures, reducing manual processes and increasing data retrieval efficiency.

• Maintain and deploy scalable infrastructure using OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure), ensuring high availability and performance of critical applications.

positions.title: Systems Technology Architect Intern III
positions.description:
(T-mobile acquired Sprint)Implemented workflows involving integrating SQL Database information to automate Server tasks, Built workflows using JavaScript scriptlets to automate Linux / Windows servers, Created Python scripts to interact with HPOO GUI and other UI interfaces 

· Automated Python workflows (+30% efficiency) and improved internal JavaScript UI.

· Reduced incident workload by 8% through process and tooling improvements

positions.title: Java Tutor
positions.description: Tutor students who were enrolled in Java For Business class at Emporia State University, via Skype and email.

projects.title: Database Design Project(PhpMyAdmin)
projects.description: Based on a Sod Company, this project was built to practice designing a database, using PhpMyAdmin, Built to practice demonstrating database design principles. Little to no focus on actually entering data into the database just the overall design.

projects.title: Fortnite Stats Database
projects.description: Wanted to practice with a small database of statistics, so I used a java web scraper to help me populate a small database to play around with
